author: Robin_DD_J
body:
Floating Wasteland!
YML: http://pastebin.com/L85gtESn
Download: https://www.dropbox.com/s/l3xtdjzwx69ohsz/New%20World%20-%20kopia.rar?dl=0
Gamemode: DTM

  • You'll spawn in a room where you can pick if you want to go to the right, or left side of the map.
  • You won't spawn with golden apples, instead there are spawners on the left and right side that will spawn that for you.
  • Under the diamonds you'll find tnt. Hurry up to water them!
  • Under the iron-rooms you'll find tnt! Finally a map with tnt.

Pictures: http://imgur.com/a/kBsvU
